text:
Riley: Heads up 111 Launch plan for Spark benchmark + webinar. Need X + LinkedIn posts, 2 short clips (15s, 30s), hero, 3 caption variants, and clear inbound lead routing. Can we lock timelines today?

Cam: Yep. What's the webinar time? Ill map regional posting windows.

Riley: May 26 2026 10:00 AM PT / 1:00 PM ET. Posting cadence: teaser 48h prior, live launch posts at T+5 mins, follow-up next day with clip.

Priya: Ill write captions: variant A = benchmark-first (stat heavy), B = product narrative, C = customer POV. Uploading to Notion in 30.

Devon: Design can handle hero + clips. Need specs and filename convention.

Sofia: Growth ops will own tracking + lead handoff. Recommend form -> HubSpot -> Zap -> #sdr-triage. Add lead tag spark_may26 + lifecycle=webinar.

Cam: Draft schedule for ops: 
```
May 24 09:00 PT - X teaser (image)
May 26 10:05 PT - X launch thread (headline + 2 replies)
May 26 10:10 PT - LinkedIn post (company)
May 27 09:00 PT - X follow-up + 30s clip
```
Will include timezone variants.

Riley: UTMs: utm_source=x|li, utm_medium=social, utm_campaign=spark_may26. Shorten link via bit.ly/spark-launch. Pinned reply should have TL;DR + register.

Priya: Drafts in Notion -> https://notion.so/redwood/spark-captions (placeholder). Added short hooks for X + long form for LinkedIn.

Devon: What sizes?

Cam: X hero 1600x900, LinkedIn 1200x627, clips 1920x1080 H.264. Filenames: spark_hero_<platform>_v1.png, spark_clip_15s_v1.mp4, spark_clip_30s_v1.mp4.

Devon: Cool, starting assets. ETA EOD tomorrow. Will drop to /marketing/assets/spark.

Sofia: Zap recipe posted -> https://zapier.com/shared/yyy (placeholder). Test flow ok: form -> enrich -> create lead -> Slack notify #sdr-triage. Adding priority flag when company_size>100.

Riley: Also want a quick benchmark stat in the headline. Priya, pass me the top stat you want to highlight.

Priya: Draft stat: "Spark reduces median inference latency by 2.3x vs baseline". Will add citation in Notion.

Cam: Ill draft the X thread template: headline, stat card, clip/GIF, CTA. Two canned replies for engagement (ask for use case, sign-up CTA).

mkt-bot: Calendar event created: "Spark launch go/no-go" May 25 08:30 AM PT.

Devon: Assets uploaded -> https://storage.redwood/assets/spark (placeholder). 1600x900 hero + both clips present.

Priya: Final captions posted in Notion with 3 headline options.

Sofia: Zap live in test mode. Slack notifications look like: "New Spark lead: {name}  score:{score}  tag:spark_may26".

Riley: Good work. Before EOD: Devon confirm assets live (reply here), Priya lock captions, Cam queue drafts but hold publish, Sofia validate Zap permissions with sales. Well run the go/no-go on May 25.

Cam: Scheduled drafts queued in Buffer. Holding publish until assets + captions are confirmed.

Devon: Confirmed  assets are live and filenames follow conv.

Sofia: Sales verified Zap permissions and #sdr-triage watchlist enabled.

Riley: :rocket: Perfect. Post-launch: Leo (growth)  prepare 48h pulse report (engagement, clicks, reg conversions). Ping if blockers.
